message: No detected input validation: The code loads config from JSON and reads a graph via nx.read_gpickle without any schema checks, type assertions, or value-range guards on the config parameters or graph data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path ('data/' + config['data'] + '.gpickle') with no remote source fetching, checksum verification, or authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code compares label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The graph is loaded directly from a gpickle file and passed straight to the model without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a graph from a gpickle file and trains embedding models from scratch; there is no loading of pretrained weights or serialized models, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any stress-testing logic are present anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The evaluate.py simply prints score dictionaries to a file with no hashing, signing, held-out set isolation enforcement, or multiple independent metric verification to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads config and graph data without any validation of input shape, range, schema, or malformed input checks before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or any sanity validation before results are used or saved.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses graph embedding methods (node2vec, GraRep, LINE, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
